Amendment to the PR body (the dev writes the body once; corrections go here).

**One sentence in the body is wrong.** Under 「What changed」 the body says that after the edit, `git grep -n 'Reviewed-by-account\|另一账户\|25415' -- .claude scripts` names nothing. That reading was taken before the regression assertion was added and is false after it: on head `dea17d5745` the grep names four lines in `scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` — L4154, L4157, L4161 and L4169 — all inside the new self-test case in the Tier S battery. L4154 and L4157 are the case's comment (the maintainer's quoted sentence, and the word 「另一账户」 inside it); L4161 plants a `Reviewed-by-account:` line in the fixture record so the case proves the guard ignores it; L4169 asserts the rendering never prints that key or an account comparison. They are the pin that keeps the retired leg retired, not a remnant of the rule: no rule text, reader, refusal line or clear line carries the words, and the `.claude/**` tree names nothing. The whole-tree grep for the removed symbol names (`accountIndependence`, `readReviewedByAccount`, `readAttributionLogin`, `REVIEWED_BY_ACCOUNT_LINE`, `independenceRefusalLines`) still names nothing. Everything else in the body stands as written.

**Head moved once:** `origin/main` (`ce18e734`, one commit, none of the three files) was merged in as `dea17d5745` per the claim's 「Merge main before asking for review」. On that head: guard self-test exit 0 (335 cases), recogniser self-test exit 0 (201 cases), `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` exit 0, trailer check exit 0 (2 commits, model-free pair).

Written 2026-10-24T02:01Z by an isolated contract-review subagent of `domain:skills` seat 2. Inputs: card #25568 (body and its one comment, claim 6378095856), PR #25585 (body, file list, `git diff origin/main...dea17d5769` with `origin/main` = `ce18e73483`), the dev's body amendment 6378419139 (read as a claim, judged below), the head's check-runs (polled until none was in progress, the reads listed under ①), `git show 041a120b61` (#25436), and the maintainer ruling 6378076465 on PR #25552 quoting the maintainer verbatim: 「守卫在合并队列里只认「另一账户复审」，这个没必要，去掉这条规则」 (2026-10-24T01:16Z), 「立skills卡」. The dispatch order and the dispatching seat's conclusions were not inputs. Nothing was built, run or re-run locally: the tier was read off the register's source, the self-tests and the ratchet off the head's check-runs.

### ① Derived judgments

**The guard change is a faithful revert of #25436's account leg and nothing else.** `git diff 041a120b61^ dea17d5769 -- scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs` is exactly one hunk: the 18-line regression case at L4154–L4171 of the guard. Everything else in both files is byte-identical to the tree before #25436 landed (`git log 041a120b61..origin/main -- scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs` is empty, so no later commit's hunks had to be re-woven). Concretely, on the head: `accountIndependence`, the `not-independent` state, `independenceRefusalLines`, the 「accounts compared」 clear line, the `attributionLogin` recogniser wiring and its `missing` key, the `attribution` parameter of `recordVerdict`, the attribution read in `runGuard`, the header paragraph and the 10-case battery are gone; `recordVerdict` ends at `return { state: 'stands', ...found }` as it did before #25436, and the three refusal branches that remain (`below-tier`, `unreadable`, `unsigned`) are untouched. The approval limb and the size line are untouched. In `record-recognisers.mjs`: `readReviewedByAccount`, `readAttributionLogin`, `REVIEWED_BY_ACCOUNT_LINE`, `GITHUB_LOGIN`, `ATTRIBUTION_LINE`, the locator's `account` field, the two header-roster lines and the 7-case battery are gone; `--template` output is unchanged (the template never printed an account line). Right.

**Leftover references.** `git grep -i` on the head over `scripts/`, `.claude/`, `.github/`, `AGENTS.md`, `docs/` for `accountIndependence`, `not-independent`, `attributionLogin`, `readReviewedByAccount`, `readAttributionLogin`, `REVIEWED_BY_ACCOUNT_LINE`, `independenceRefusalLines`, `#25415`/`25415`, `github_login`, `attribution` (under `.claude`), 「另一账户」, 「同账户」, 「长期授权」 names nothing except four lines inside the new regression case of `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs`: L4154 (the maintainer's sentence quoted in the case comment, which contains 「另一账户」), L4157 (comment), L4161 (the fixture plants `Reviewed-by-account:` in the record so the case proves it is ignored), L4169 (the assertion that the rendering never prints that key). No reader, rule line, refusal line or clear line carries the words; the `.claude/**` tree and `.github/**` carry none. The dev's amendment 6378419139 makes exactly this claim (four lines, those four numbers, fixture and comment, nothing else) and it is true on the head. Right.

**Self-test floors.** Guard: one battery removed (10 cases), `SELF_TEST_BATTERY_FLOOR` 28 → 27, and the 「Raised 27 → 28」 comment line goes with it — one battery, one row, the convention the comment block states. Recognisers: one battery removed (7 cases), floor 13 → 12, same shape. Both match the batteries actually removed. The regression case is added to the existing Tier S battery 「⭐ #18020 → #19133 Tier S: a review of record, not an approval」 whose pinned count stays 43 (the pin is a floor — the roster check passes a battery whose registered count is at or above its pinned number — so 44 against 43 passes); see ③ for the one consequence. Right.

**The regression assertion is meaningful.** `recordComment()` on the head emits the exact line 'Reviewed-by: `session_01SEAT`' (L4097), so the `.replace` plants a real `Reviewed-by-account: lane-account-a` line; the PR body fixture carries `claude-projects-attribution` with the same login; the case drives the live `runGuard` on `merge_group` and asserts exit CLEAR, conclusion `cleared`, `record.state === 'stands'`, and that `renderGuardVerdict` prints none of `Reviewed-by-account`, `accounts compared`, `SAME account` — the render never quotes comment bodies, so those strings can only come from guard-generated text. On `main` this same fixture reads `attribution = read(lane-account-a)`, `account = read(lane-account-a)`, `same-account` → `not-independent` → exit 3, so the case discriminates the two trees; the dev's ablation claim (re-applying the #25436 hunks reds this one case) is consistent with that reading and was not re-run here. It pins the retired leg retired. Right.

**contract-review.md: exactly the six lines, and nothing dangles.** Deleted on the head: L36 「项目席落地的 Tier S:`Reviewed-by:` 须属 PR 作者外的账户;同账户子代理只算复核。」, L37 「作者账户 = PR 正文 attribution 的 `github_login`;记录另带 `Reviewed-by-account:` 行写复核账户。」, L38 「只动散文面、不欠契约复核的 PR 同欠另一账户一条 `TIER_DEFAULT` 记录;⛔ 散文面无豁免。」, L41 「① 在项目席另加:`Reviewed-by-account:` 的登录须异于 PR attribution 的登录,队列守卫同判。」, L42–L43 「过渡:无另一账户在席时,① 的替代 = 维护者本人在执行线程的话:逐个点名 PR 编号,/ 或对该席位的 Tier S 长期授权(一句可撤)。」 — the same six the ruling enumerates by text; the ruling's line numbers (L38/L39/L40/L43/L44–45 「main 041a120b」) are two high against that tree, where the lines sit at L36/L37/L38/L41/L42–43 exactly as on `origin/main`, so the text, not the numbers, was matched. Kept: L35 「独立性对:`Implemented-by:`/`Reviewed-by:` 取值同见 `--template`;子代理记采纳它的席位。」 (session independence, which the ruling says stays), L36 「轮次报告设复审清单专节…」, L37 「落地前检两条…① 达档条款②复核 PASS 在案(同形记录)。」, L38–L39 the 例外, L40 「② PR check 全绿…」. Read line by line, no surviving line refers to a removed one: ① now means only 「达档条款②复核 PASS 在案」, ② is the CI line, the 例外 points at 「上列散文面」 (L9–L10, present). 55 → 49 lines. On the prose-face `TIER_DEFAULT` line: #25422's own body introduced it as part of its item ① (「只动散文面的 PR 同样欠另一账户一条 TIER_DEFAULT 记录」), i.e. as the vehicle for the other account's review and nothing else; with the account rationale gone, keeping it would contradict L20 「四面皆不碰 ⇒ CI 加席位自读 ⛔ 不起第二个 agent」 and L10 (prose faces are the dispatching seat's ACCEPT). Deleting it is right.

**Elsewhere under `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**`.** No line requires a second account for a Tier S landing and none cites the deleted lines. Three lines still describe a cross-account *patrol* that #25422 (item ③) and #25427 added alongside the rule: `dispatch-runbook.md` L44 「跨账户复审:每项目巡查跑 `is:pr is:open label:needs:contract-review`,剔除本账户署名的 PR。」, L45 「复核前在 PR 留 `Claim:` 形评论(会话、账户);已有他账户的认领即跳过,⛔ 不双做。」 (L46 「复核照 `contract-review.md`;PASS 同笔摘标记…」 is account-neutral), and `project-forms.md` L9 「车道席:认领、派发、PR、跨账号复审;…」 / L28 「项目聊天里的长句(「本账户坐 X;Y 的 PR 由本账户复审」)是等价写法。」. They are a duty roster (who may pick up a PR awaiting review), not a landing condition; they are coherent with the head (the marker section L45–L49 still exists, in-seat review still covers a seat's own PRs), and they were not matched by the card's prescribed grep (`Reviewed-by-account\|另一账户\|25415`) nor named by the ruling. Not a defect of this PR; named under ③ as a follow-up.

**Ratchet.** `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` L550 keeps `['.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md', 60]`; the file is 49 lines (headroom 11). The ratchet discipline (script header L64–L65) is 「A ceiling may be LOWERED by any PR that shrinks its file — lowering is always legitimate and encouraged」 — may, not must; #25422 itself left the row at 60 while landing 54. Leaving it is within convention; lowering it to 49 is encouraged and is the seat's call (③). Right as it stands.

**Commit trailers and rule text.** Branch commit `9522958a0e` carries `Claude-Session:` and `Co-authored-by: Claude` (the noreply address) — the model-free pair, no model identifier. The merge commit `dea17d5769` carries no trailer, which `check-commit-card-trailers.mjs` reads as clean (its own self-test, 「the merge commit os-regen-merge writes carries no trailer at all and is clean」). The diff adds no rule text at all (contract-review.md is deletions only); the only added lines are the self-test case in a script, whose fixture login `lane-account-a` is a fixture, not a real login. Right.

**Tier and surface.** The PR's three paths against the register on the head: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md` hits row `claude-tree` (`.claude/**`, `GOVERNED_TIER_S`, `tierRepos: ['objectstack']`); the two `scripts/pm/**` files hit no row. Tier S, one `.claude/**` hit, governed-rules face ⇒ `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`. No Tier H path. +24/−264, far under the human-merge size line. Right.

**Merge.** The head is a merge of `9522958a0e` with `origin/main` `ce18e73483` (#25560, four files, none of the three here); the net diff against `origin/main` is exactly the three files. Right.

**Check-runs on this head.** Read 2026-10-24T01:53Z: 23 runs, 12 in progress. Read 2026-10-24T01:56Z: 37 runs, 7 in progress. Read 2026-10-24T01:57Z (twice): 38 runs, 4 then 3 in progress. Read 2026-10-24T01:58Z: 38 runs, 2 in progress (`Test Core (1/6)`, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`). Last read 2026-10-24T02:00Z: 39 runs — 29 `success`, 9 `skipped`, 0 failed, 1 still in progress (`Test Core (1/6)`, started 2026-10-24T01:53Z). Every gate this diff reaches is already green: `Governed Surface Queue Guard` (runs the guard self-test first, then the pull_request leg), `Lint · repo & tooling gates` (carries `check:pm-skill-ratchet`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:pm-record-recognisers`, `check:pm-governed-prose`), `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` (frame-sync and frame-freshness), `Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests`, `Lint · ESLint`, the two required aggregates `Lint & Repo Gates` and `TypeScript Type Check`, `The card this PR closes must claim this branch`, `No other open PR may claim the same issue`, `Check PR Size`; `Check Changeset` is `skipped` under `skip-changeset`; `Test Core` 2/6–6/6 are `success`. The one open shard exercises workspace package tests that this diff (no package file) cannot change; this record's verdict is on rule content and does not wait on it, but the seat's landing check ② (「PR check 全绿」) does: the seat confirms `Test Core (1/6)` `success` before queueing, and a red there is judged by the merge-base signature rule, not re-reviewed here.

### ② Semver level

No published package is touched: `.claude/**` and two `scripts/pm/**` gates ship in no package. No `.changeset` file in the diff; the `skip-changeset` label is on the PR and `Check Changeset` is `skipped` under it — the right form for this repository. `Clause-②: no` is correct: the change widens the accept set of a CI gate (the queue guard stops refusing a same-account record), not of any published schema or API, and declares no narrowing. `Metadata-protocol: none` is correct. PASS.

### ③ Boundary flags

- **Dev flag — the body's grep sentence (amendment 6378419139).** The body's 「`git grep -n 'Reviewed-by-account\|另一账户\|25415' -- .claude scripts` names nothing」 is false on the head and the amendment says so; judged above: the four lines named are exactly the hits, all fixture or comment inside the regression case, no rule or reader text. Accepted as corrected. One defect in the amendment itself: it names the head as `dea17d5745` twice; no such object exists (`git rev-parse dea17d5745` fails), the head is `dea17d5769…`. The seat should note the typo when adopting this record; it changes nothing judged here.
- **Dev flag — `TIER_DEFAULT` prose-face line.** The card left it to the implementer to read against its source; the dev deleted it citing #25422. Agreed, with the reading in ① (#25422's own body ties the line to the other account).
- **Dev flag — ratchet row left at 60.** Within convention; lowering to 49 is encouraged by the script's own discipline and costs one integer. The seat may do it on this branch (no new record needed if the head moves on that one row alone is not a prose-only move — a changed `scripts/pm/**` line is not a prose face — so a re-render would be owed; the cheaper path is a one-line follow-up PR).
- **Not a dev flag — the Tier S battery's pinned count stays 43 while the battery now has 44 cases.** The new regression case is therefore not itself floored: deleting it later would not red the roster check. Raising the row to 44 would floor it; one integer, follow-up or on this branch at the seat's call.
- **Not a dev flag — cross-account patrol lines survive.** `dispatch-runbook.md` L44–L45 and `project-forms.md` L9/L28 (quoted in ①) still prescribe a per-project patrol that reviews other accounts' `needs:contract-review` PRs. Outside the ruling's enumerated removal and outside the card's grep; coherent with the head; whether the patrol itself is still wanted now that the guard owes it nothing is the maintainer's to say — one line for the next ruling batch, not this PR.
- **Landing note (card).** The guard's `merge_group` job checks out the merge-group commit, so this PR's own queue run is judged by the guard it ships; the new case proves that guard clears a same-account record. After it lands, PR #25552 (card #25507) is re-armed by the skills seat; this record authorises nothing on #25552.
- `open_questions`: none declared in the PR body or the amendment beyond the items above.
